name: TN-06
label: Likely R

model.rationale: The R+13 district and the Republican nominee's massive fundraising edge over a nearly unfunded Democratic opponent make this a heavily Republican-leaning open seat. Prediction markets price a Republican win at roughly 94%, consistent with the fundamentals.
model.watch: A major national Democratic wave environment or unexpected Republican nominee controversy could narrow the margin, though a Democratic win remains unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: John Rose (R) is not on the ballot.

overview:
This open Tennessee seat is strongly Republican territory, with a partisan lean of about thirteen points toward the GOP. John Rose's retirement to run for governor leaves the seat without an incumbent, but the Republican nominee Johnny Garrett enters with a decisive financial advantage, having raised over $2.3 million and drawn outside support, while Democrat Mike Croley has raised only about $35,000 with minimal cash on hand.

Prediction markets price a Republican win at roughly 94 percent, and no expert raters or general-election polls are available to suggest otherwise. The forecast expects a Republican hold by a comfortable double-digit margin, with the open-seat nature and thin polling keeping uncertainty somewhat elevated.
